title: Canary rollout scratchpad — Lucas Hernandez
content:
Notes to self / scratchpad for upcoming canary rollout (runtime v1.3.0)

Purpose:
- Stage a gradual canary for runtime v1.3.0 (kernel selection + batching improvements) to verify latency and error-rate impact on real traffic.
- Validate model pinning behavior for customers on Dedicated and Private.
- Have clear rollback and alert thresholds defined before each percentage increase.

High level plan (candidate):
- 00:00 - baseline snapshot (metric baseline + traffic segments)
- 00:30 - deploy control + canary instances on us-west-2 (subset of pool)
- 01:00 - route 1% traffic -> canary
- 02:00 - route 5% -> canary (if checks pass)
- 04:00 - route 20% -> canary (if checks pass)
- 24:00 - if stable, promote canary to 100% for warm pools (stagger remaining regions)

Quick checklist (pre-deploy):
- [ ] Confirm RLSE-4123 is green + release notes attached to PR #781
- [ ] Update model pin map: runtime v1.2.x pinned for customers with strict SLOs (see pin list)
- [ ] Ensure canary instances have isolated cost tags and logs enabled
- [ ] Bake in active tracing (X-Request-Id propagation) and sampling ramped up for canary
- [ ] Notify oncall + post in #releases 30m before first traffic shift

Version pinning notes:
- Customers with "pin:stable" currently get runtime v1.2.9. We MUST NOT change their pin without approval.
- For this canary, only route unpinned + dev-cust groups. Check pin resolution flow: config service returns explicit pin if set (ticket: CONF-887).
- Edge case: dual-variant fallback — if model variant mismatch occurs, request should fall back to pinned variant and log a metric 'pin_fallback'. Monitor closely.

Monitoring / thresholds (auto-check script will validate):
- Error rate (4xx/5xx): trigger if canary > 0.5% absolute increase vs baseline or > 0.2% absolute and sustained 10m.
- Latency: P95 increase > 25% over baseline OR P95 > 350ms => alarm.
- Vocal regressions: prompt-eval set (prompt-set: canary-regress-2026-02) must not drop more than 2% in quality score.
- Resource anomalies: GPU mem pressure > 85% for 3 consecutive samples => investigate.
- Log spikes: unexpected exception signature: "kv_cache_mismatch" treat as immediate stop and rollback.

Dashboards / queries to watch:
- Dashboard: "canary/runtime-v1.3.0 - latency & errors" (link in Confluence page)
- Prometheus queries (notes):
  - rate(http_requests_total{job="runtime",version="v1.3.0",region="us-west-2"}[5m])
  - increase(http_errors_total{job="runtime",region="us-west-2",version="v1.3.0"}[10m]) / increase(http_requests_total{...}[10m])
  - histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{version="v1.3.0"}[5m])) by (le))

Rollback criteria (immediate):
- Any crash-looping instance or OOM observed on canary cluster
- Fatal exceptions containing "kv_cache_mismatch" or "kernel-assert"
- Error rate threshold exceeded per above OR sustained P95 > 400ms for 15m
- If rollback: revert routing config, scale canary down to 0, tag incidents, and open postmortem template (link).

Run of show (owner = me):
- pre-deploy (T-1h): announce; run smoke tests against canary binaries
- deploy: push canary ASG with tag canary=lukescratch
- shift: use routing service (routectl shift --service runtime --version v1.3.0 --pct 1)
- monitor: check dashboard every 5m for first hour, then every 15m
- escalation: if thresholds hit, ping oncall (@noah) and paging SRE channel

Post-deploy tasks:
- If stable at 24h: update release notes, bump default runtime in model-catalog service for unpinned customers
- Run full eval set overnight and attach results to RLSE-4123
- Sync with solutions-eng on Dedicated customer pins that requested freeze window

Open questions / TODOs:
- TODO: confirm whether dedicated customers with reserved capacity get automatic fallback to older kernels (ask platform-eng)
- Q: Do we need to pre-warm KV cache for canary to avoid cold-start noise? (probably yes for end-to-end fairness)
- TODO: add a short canary-specific smoke test to ci/canary-smoke (coverage: prefix caching + streaming)
- TODO: get sign-off from product-hosted-api for any API surface changes in runtime v1.3.0

Local commands cheat-sheet:
- routectl get --service runtime --region us-west-2 --output yaml
- routectl shift --service runtime --version v1.3.0 --pct 5 --region us-west-2
- kubectl -n runtime logs -l app=runtime,release=canary --tail=200
- prometheus query examples: use grafana Explore or prometheus api

Notes / scribbles:
- If we see small latency bump but stable error rate, consider keeping canary longer and increasing sampling of tracing to pinpoint kernel hot-paths.
- Keep an eye on dedicated pools: there was a bug last month where fallback mapping returned null for pinned customers (CONF-887) — watch for increased 'pin_fallback' metric.
- Reminder: update postmortem template with average cost delta for canary vs baseline (token cost + GPU minutes)

-- Lucas
